title: UK FCDO travel-advice updates and the statements in force, from GOV.UK and Wayback captures
description: One row per FCDO update to a country's travel advice, with the FCDO's own note, the 'advise against' statements in force after it, and whether it changed them. For replaying triage's FCDO notices (kind fcdo; counted only where the statements changed).

sources.name: GOV.UK Content API, foreign travel advice, change history
sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office)

sources.name: GOV.UK foreign travel advice pages, as captured by the Internet Archive
sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office); captures by the Internet Archive

differences: Live Cordon marks an item anomaly when its own diff saw the statements change; here the change is read from page captures and dated to an update's time, so an update that is not the real cause can carry the flag (estimated-date).
A change that went in and out between two captures is missed.
Statements are read from the page's warning text (whole country or parts, all travel or all but essential), not from alert_status, which the API gives only for today.
The change history lists only updates the FCDO published as such; the API may omit older notes.
method.commit_note: Cherry-picked onto main from 7e29196 (branch claude/history-cordon-d273c9); same code.

biases: Update dates and times are exact (the FCDO's own); the statements by date are only as good as the page captures around them.
Whole-country versus parts is read from wording; a destination named neither as the country nor as parts is read as parts and flagged parsed-best-effort.
Countries the Archive captured rarely have long carried-forward stretches (capture-gap).

row_schema.name: country
row_schema.alert_status: statements in force after the update, or null
row_schema.alert_status_changed: true when this update changed the statements
row_schema.from_alert_status: the statements before it, when changed
row_schema.status_refs: Wayback captures the statements were read from

uses: base rates of FCDO statement changes per country-day
not_for: a legal or authoritative record of what the FCDO advised on a day
